Nothing reads the field yet. `finalize()` still posts `subtotal_cents + tax_cents` to the ledger, so a discount won't change the posted amount until you subtract it there. I left that alone because it changes what gets posted to the ledger. Say if you want it done.

Because the new field has a default and comes after `tax_cents`, any code that builds `Invoice` with positional arguments past `tax_cents` would now pass its value to `discount_cents`. I didn't search the repo for such callers.
